podcast.title: Canadian Two-Piece Band
podcast.body: Black Pistol Fire is mentioned as part of a new generation of two-piece rock bands, notably among several Canadian acts that flourished in the 21st century. "A lot of this new generation were Canadian. Black pistol fire, death from above 1979."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
